mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a quarter indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% for 3 consecutive months) signals a potential for monetary easing, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real interest rates decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL was below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a quarter suggests a strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase & UNRATE decrease in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased and UNRATE decreased over a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where the nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) is consistently above its 12-month moving average indicates a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS was above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer spending are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declined by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter.
